description: See an area from above, as text: a 41 by 41 grid around near [x,y,z], reaching r metres each way (1 to 100, default 30), north (-z) at the top. Each character is the height of the tallest thing in that cell (1-9 metres, then letters); . is empty ground, _ is something at or below ground, and * is a creature's home where nothing else stands. Use it to check the layout of what you built, and to find empty ground before world_claim. Shapes are drawn as their bounding boxes, in their rest pose; world_look gives the ids, sizes and authors of what stands there. Read-only, no token. Optional room (default: your current room).
name: world_map
